Author: NiGuangOwO
Name: DalamudMCP
Description:
通过 MCP（模型上下文协议）连接 AI 助手与 FINAL FANTASY XIV，为 Dalamud 插件开发、运行时分析和游戏内验证提供工具。

读取角色、物品栏、游戏数据、界面文本与运行日志，检查插件和 IPC，并在授权后执行界面交互等操作。

安装后输入 /dalamudmcp 打开设置，并配置支持 MCP 的 AI 客户端。默认仅开放只读工具；修改游戏状态的工具需手动启用。仅支持 stdio 的客户端可使用配套桥接程序。

Connect AI agents to FINAL FANTASY XIV through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Dalamud plugin development, runtime analysis, and in-game validation.

Read character, inventory, game data, UI text, and runtime logs; inspect plugins and IPC; and perform UI interactions with explicit permission.

After installation, open settings with /dalamudmcp and configure an MCP-compatible AI client. Only read-only tools are enabled by default; tools that change game state must be enabled manually. A companion bridge is available for stdio-only clients.
Punchline: 连接 AI 助手，辅助插件开发与调试 | AI-assisted plugin development & debugging.
